verdict.rationale: Bento's Workflows concept explicitly supports branching, delays, and decision logic ('when this happens, do that... branch, delay, make decisions'), Sequences support timed multi-step email series, and workflows can be built from behavior/events/tags with branch validation. Welcome/onboarding/winback use cases are implied by trigger+segment+tag combinations but not explicitly named as templates, and no exit-rule terminology or third-party hands-on review of complex automation flows is present. Missing for 10: explicit named 'exit rules' mechanism, first-party or independent case study showing a full welcome/onboarding/winback build, and screenshots/hands-on validation of branch complexity.
